description: Indiana unemployment insurance provides temporary income after a qualifying loss of work. File the initial claim and continuing weekly vouchers through Uplink.
introduction: Indiana unemployment insurance provides temporary income after a qualifying loss of work. File the initial claim and continuing weekly vouchers through Uplink.

sections.who: Losing work through no fault of your own may qualify you. DWD also reviews earnings and continuing eligibility. Its monetary determination describes potential benefits; it does not itself approve the claim.
sections.get: Eligible claimants receive weekly payments. DWD decides the award and whether any issues concerning the claim must be investigated.
sections.docs:
• A valid email address for your Uplink username.
  • Identification, address, Social Security number and contact details.
  • Your last employer’s contact details, employment dates and reason for separation.
  • Bank details if you choose direct deposit.
sections.apply:
1. File promptly

    Read the claimant handbook and use the filing route on DWD’s application page.

  2. File weekly vouchers

    Begin the week after applying. Report earnings and keep filing while a claim issue or appeal is pending.

  3. Maintain work-search records

    DWD currently requires two qualifying activities each week unless a waiver applies. Keep supporting records.
sections.after: Check your Uplink claimant page for requests and decisions. DWD can review work-search evidence; its guidance says to retain confirmations for six months.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using initial claim and voucher instructions, work-search activities and waivers, unemployment overview and handbook. The provider makes eligibility decisions.

faqs: Does a monetary determination mean approval?
No. DWD separately determines claim eligibility.
Should I file vouchers during an appeal?
Yes. DWD instructs claimants to continue weekly vouchers while an appeal or delayed issue is pending.
DWD lists specific waivers, including approved training and certain job-attached or hiring-hall situations. Confirm your status with DWD.
